title: Waste of money!
text: Waste of money!. The side brushes are horrible. I put new ones on about 3 weeks ago and since then, I have found bristles in every room of my house, every single time I use my Deebot. One brush is almost completely bald now. Everything else seems to be ok but the side brushes. I won't be buying this brand again.
